admission.scope: Pinned native lowering, one CTA and declared finite correction visits; common frontend control, resolved operands, resources and native assumptions held fixed

execute.assumption_reporting: triggered=null means applicability was not measured or analysis was not reached

assumptions.text: All lanes' TMEM reads complete before any lane receives its register results.
Matching same-warp duplicate TMA stores are reported as warnings instead of races.
Memory effects are immediately visible when executed; visibility fences add no ordering constraints. Async completion and synchronization remain modeled.
Election selects lane zero when participating, otherwise the lowest participating lane.
Every cluster launch cancellation request fails.
